nodeGroups.name: Decision Security & State Gate
nodeGroups.description: Detects link-preview bots cleanly, validates query/POST commit params, verifies token & idempotency, and routes decisions.

nodeGroups.name: Hold & Audit
nodeGroups.description: Marks lead HELD without sending client email, writes ZL_Audit_Log, alerts Slack, and returns confirmation.

nodeGroups.name: Pre-Dispatch Slot Verification
nodeGroups.description: Queries ZL_Bookings to detect overlapping confirmed appointments before outbound dispatch.

nodeGroups.name: Slot Conflict Guardrail
nodeGroups.description: Halts dispatch on slot collision, marks lead SLOT_CONFLICT, audits, alerts Slack, and returns 409.

nodeGroups.name: Safe Dispatch & Booking Confirmation
nodeGroups.description: Sends approved client reply with SMTP error guard, commits ZL_Bookings slot, marks DISPATCHED, and logs audit trail.

nodeGroups.name: Security & Rejection Handling
nodeGroups.description: Renders safe confirmation preview on GET and handles 409 idempotency, 403 token rejection, and 404 lookups.
